name: OSU RCRV: real 3D production model (ShipConstructor, via APS)
provenance_note: Real ShipConstructor production model (structure + piping), converted with Autodesk APS. No rooms or corridors in this model, so escape-route rules cannot run on it; the checks use material, grade, thickness, SWBS, pipe material, opening sizes from item names, and design status. Model unit: inches, converted to mm.

ship.name: Regional Class Research Vessel (Oregon State University)

length_overall.note: about 60.65 m (199 ft); OSU press material says 193 ft

class_society.note: The model names materials with ABS grade designations ("CS ABS A"); the hull steel grades (IACS UR W11) are the same under DNV.
